cues.text: Which list is the real one?
Every list you already own comes in through the same import screen.
Excel, CSV or TSV uploads, and the columns are detected by header.
Nothing is written until you confirm the preview, and duplicates are listed.
A repeat buyer is combined, so the owner, stage and history survive.
The new leads then reach your agents by your own distribution rules.
One import screen for every list Book a demo.
